subject.title: fix(ai): preserve compat xhigh reasoning effort

question: Should `supportedReasoningEfforts` and `reasoningEffortMap` become the supported public `models.json` contract for OpenAI-compatible Completions and Responses providers?
rationale: The patch adds schema-accepted, runtime-consumed compatibility fields across shared types and both transports; deciding whether these fields are a permanent provider configuration API is a maintainer product and compatibility choice, not a mechanical code correction.

options.title: Adopt the compat contract
options.body: Accept these fields as the provider-facing contract, require current-head live provider proof, and land with conservative explicit-support gating.

options.title: Keep compatibility internal
options.body: Avoid exposing the fields through custom model schemas until maintainers choose a narrower provider-owned configuration surface.

options.title: Use a different provider model
options.body: Pause this PR and route extended reasoning capabilities through an approved provider-profile or catalog mechanism instead of generic compat metadata.

recommendation.title: Adopt the compat contract
recommendation.body: Accept these fields as the provider-facing contract, require current-head live provider proof, and land with conservative explicit-support gating.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior merged xhigh compatibility work in the adjacent runtime path makes this the strongest available feature-history routing signal.
